mapper.select: SELECT aio.id, aio.event_id, aio.change_kind, aio.payload, aio.status, aio.retry_count, aio.max_retry, aio.next_retry_at, aio.last_error, aio.locked_by, aio.locked_at, aio.processed_at, aio.source_module, aio.source_biz_id, aio.create_time, aio.update_time, aio.create_user, aio.update_user, aio.remark FROM sys_authorization_invalidation_outbox aio WHERE aio.id = #{id}

SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_count, SUM(CASE WHEN aio.status = 'PENDING' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS pending_count, SUM(CASE WHEN aio.status = 'PROCESSING' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS processing_count, SUM(CASE WHEN aio.status = 'SUCCESS' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS success_count, SUM(CASE WHEN aio.status = 'FAILED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS failed_count, SUM(CASE WHEN aio.status = 'DEAD' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS dead_count FROM sys_authorization_invalidation_outbox aio
